passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to Aaron.
Aaron was the high priest.
The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron this.”
“When you set up the lamps on the lampstand, do this.”
“There are seven lamps on the lampstand.”
“Arrange the seven lamps so they shine light in front of the lampstand.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֵלָ֑יו בְּהַעֲלֹֽתְךָ֙ אֶת־ הַנֵּרֹ֔ת אֶל־ מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה יָאִ֖ירוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת הַנֵּרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses how to arrange the lamps on the lampstand.
Aaron obeyed the LORD’s command.
Aaron set up the lamps.
He placed the lamps facing the front of the lampstand.
Aaron did exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל־ מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה הֶעֱלָ֖ה נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: This is how the lampstand was constructed: it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand was made of gold.
The gold was hammered.
The lampstand was hammered from its base to its blossoms.
The lampstand followed a specific pattern.
The LORD showed this pattern to Moses.
The lampstand was made exactly as the LORD showed Moses.
passages.original: וְזֶ֨ה מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה הַמְּנֹרָה֙ מִקְשָׁ֣ה זָהָ֔ב עַד־ יְרֵכָ֥הּ עַד־ פִּרְחָ֖הּ מִקְשָׁ֣ה הִ֑וא כַּמַּרְאֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Take the Levites from among the Israelites.
Make the Levites ceremonially clean.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ קַ֚ח אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְטִהַרְתָּ֖ אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a group chosen from among the Israelites.
God commanded Moses to make the Levites ceremonially clean.
To cleanse the Levites, sprinkle them with the water of purification.
They must shave their whole bodies.
They must wash their clothes.
These actions will make the Levites pure.
passages.original: וְכֹֽה־ תַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְטַֽהֲרָ֔ם הַזֵּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֵ֣י חַטָּ֑את וְהֶעֱבִ֤ירוּ תַ֙עַר֙ עַל־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכִבְּס֥וּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִטֶּהָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Levites.
The Levites are a special group from among the Israelites.
God told Moses to make the Levites clean.
God commanded Moses about sacrifices for the Levites.
Moses must have the Levites take a young bull.
The Levites must bring a grain offering with the bull.
The grain offering must be fine flour mixed with oil.
Moses must also take a second young bull.
The second young bull is for a sin offering.
passages.original: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֔ר וּמִנְחָת֔וֹ סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן וּפַר־ שֵׁנִ֥י בֶן־ בָּקָ֖ר תִּקַּ֥ח לְחַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
passages.sermon: The Levites are a special group chosen from the people of Israel.\r\nBring the Levites in front of the Tent of Meeting.\r\nGather all the people of Israel together.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִ֨קְהַלְתָּ֔ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special group from the people of Israel.
They serve God in the Tent of Meeting.
Bring the Levites and place them before the LORD.
Gather the Israelites.
The Israelites must lay their hands on the Levites.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
The Levites are a special group from the people of Israel.
Aaron must bring the Levites before the LORD.
He must present the Levites as a wave offering.
The Levites come from the sons of Israel.
The Levites will serve the LORD.
They will do the work of the LORD.
passages.original: וְהֵנִיף֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֤ם תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special group from the people of Israel.
The Levites must lay their hands on the heads of the bulls.
You must take two bulls.
Offer one bull to the LORD as a sin offering.
Offer the other bull to the LORD as a burnt offering.
These offerings make atonement for the Levites.
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ יִסְמְכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּרִ֑ים וַ֠עֲשֵׂה אֶת־ הָאֶחָ֨ד חַטָּ֜את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֤ד עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special group from among the Israelites.
You must bring the Levites to stand in front of Aaron.
Aaron is the high priest.
You must also bring the Levites to stand in front of Aaron’s sons.
Aaron’s sons are priests.
You must present the Levites before the LORD.
You must present the Levites as a wave offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
passages.sermon: God chose the Levites from among all the Israelites.\r\nGod separated the Levites from the other Israelites.\r\nThe Levites belong to God.
passages.original: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special group chosen by God from among the Israelites.
You must cleanse the Levites.
You must present the Levites as a wave offering to the LORD.
After you do this, the Levites may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְטִֽהַרְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם תְּנוּפָֽה׃

passages.text: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God chose the Levites from among the Israelites.
God took the Levites for Himself.
God took the Levites instead of every firstborn son of the Israelites.
God gave the Levites completely to Himself.
passages.original: כִּי֩ נְתֻנִ֨ים נְתֻנִ֥ים הֵ֙מָּה֙ לִ֔י מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תַּחַת֩ פִּטְרַ֨ת כָּל־ רֶ֜חֶם בְּכ֥וֹר כֹּל֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָקַ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃

passages.text: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God said, “Every firstborn male in Israel belongs to Me.
This includes every firstborn man.
This includes every firstborn animal.
On the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I set the firstborn of Israel apart for Myself.
I made them holy for Me on that day.”
passages.original: כִּ֣י לִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם הַכֹּתִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם הִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃

passages.text: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
passages.sermon: God chose the Levites.\r\nGod took the Levites from among the Israelites.\r\nGod took the Levites instead of every firstborn son in Israel.
passages.original: וָאֶקַּח֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֥חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֖וֹר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”
passages.sermon:
God gave the Levites to Aaron and his sons.
God chose the Levites from among the Israelites.
The Levites serve for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting.
The Levites make atonement for the Israelites.
God did this so that no plague would come on the Israelites.
This protection is for when the Israelites come near the sanctuary.
passages.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֨ה אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים׀ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֗יו מִתּוֹךְ֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַעֲבֹ֞ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּלְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶ֔גֶף בְּגֶ֥שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the high priest.
The whole congregation of Israel included all the people of Israel.
The LORD gave commands to Moses about the Levites.
Moses, Aaron, and all the Israelites obeyed the LORD.
They did everything the LORD commanded Moses about the Levites.
The Israelites acted just as the LORD told Moses.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וְכָל־ עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַלְוִיִּ֑ם כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁה֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּן־ עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
passages.sermon:
The Levites purified themselves.
The Levites washed their clothes.
Aaron presented the Levites as a wave offering before the LORD.
Aaron made atonement for the Levites.
Aaron cleansed the Levites.
passages.original: וַיִּֽתְחַטְּא֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ֙ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּ֨נֶף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְכַפֵּ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְטַהֲרָֽם׃

passages.text: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a special group in Israel.
God chose the Levites to serve Him.
God gave Moses commands for the Levites.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron’s sons also served as priests.
The Levites came to the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting was the place where Israel worshiped God.
The Levites began their work there.
They served in front of Aaron and his sons.
They did everything God commanded through Moses.
The people followed God’s instructions for the Levites.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֞ן בָּ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם לַעֲבֹ֤ד אֶת־ עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁה֙ עַל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּ֖ן עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave instructions about the Levites.
The Levites are men from the tribe of Levi.
Each Levite must be at least twenty-five years old.
Each Levite who is twenty-five or older may begin his service.
These Levites will work at the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is the place where Israel worships God.
The Levites will perform their duties there.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִבֶּן֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יָבוֹא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served in the Tent of Meeting.
God gave them special duties.
When a Levite reached the age of fifty, he stopped doing the work.
He did not serve in the work anymore.
passages.original: וּמִבֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִצְּבָ֣א הָעֲבֹדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲבֹ֖ד עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special group from the people of Israel.
They serve God at the Tent of Meeting.
When a Levite reaches the age of fifty, he must stop doing the regular work.
After this, he may help his brothers at the Tent of Meeting.
He may assist them in their duties.
He must not do the main work himself.
You must assign the Levites their responsibilities in this way.
passages.original: וְשֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת־ אֶחָ֜יו בְּאֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וַעֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָֽם׃פ
